name: Little Red Riding the Wood
source:
What if Little Red wasn't as innocent as the original story tells us? What if she was a pretty horny young woman starting to explore her own sexuality? What if all of the other persons in this story were as horny as she was? And what if the big bad wolf wasn't the most dangerous thing on her road trip to the grandmother's house?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/red_bear]Patreon[/url]]
